title: RATIB ERP Enterprise Offline Certification — Desktop-Grade Audit
certification_question: What prevents RATIB ERP from behaving like a real installed desktop application?
certification_answer: RATIB Offline is a Service-Worker cache overlay on a live PHP web app, not a sealed installed package. Boot, navigation, and survival still depend on (1) prior online warm of HTML/JS into Cache API, (2) Soft navigations that the SW can intercept, and (3) update/recovery code that can delete those caches. Hard Refresh offline, incomplete warm, SW install shell-delete, and nuclear live-escape all break the desktop contract. Identity in IndexedDB is stronger than the shell — the product can remember who you are while still failing to open the ERP UI.

issues.title: Not an installed package — warm overlay on live PHP
issues.evidence: Modules are full HTML documents in rateb-erp-ops-pages-v34; ensure() loads scripts by URL; warm MAX_URLS=40
issues.impact: Cannot guarantee every module after restart without prior warm; server-shaped UI forever
issues.enterprise_recommendation: Define Offline Install = immutable asset package + local data plane; warm becomes install step with Offline Ready certificate

issues.title: Hard Refresh offline bypasses SW
issues.file: Browser; pos-sw.js has no hard-refresh handler
issues.evidence: Chrome Ctrl+Shift+R skips SW; navigationPreload unused (grep empty)
issues.impact: Server offline + Hard Refresh → interstitial; fails desktop contract
issues.enterprise_recommendation: Installed PWA window + soft-reload only; or custom titlebar reload that goes through SW

issues.title: Install deletes offline-shell then aborts if offline
issues.evidence: cache.delete(shellUrl); cache.delete(ERP_OFFLINE_SHELL); if offline return null
issues.impact: SW update while offline can destroy shell
issues.enterprise_recommendation: Additive put only; delete old after verify; offline = no-op on shell keys

issues.title: Nuclear recovery destroys Offline ERP
issues.impact: Recovery path removes installation; violates 'only logout/revoke/user clear'
issues.enterprise_recommendation: Soft bypass navigation; never bulk-delete; debug flag only for nuclear

issues.title: Boot not fetch-free — ensure() injects scripts
issues.impact: Cache miss offline → SDK never boots

issues.title: No local business database (SQLite/OPFS)
issues.impact: Offline ERP is snapshot UI + form queue, not full transactional ERP data plane
issues.enterprise_recommendation: Desktop-grade requires local entity store + sync protocol; HTML cache alone is not ERP
